nodes.label: AMX backend segfault workaround (Sapphire Rapids)
nodes.rationale: Sapphire Rapids Xeons trigger a segfault in Ollama's AMX-accelerated CPU backend during model warmup. Fix: rename libggml-cpu-sapphirerapids.so so Ollama falls back to AVX512 (cascadelake/skylakex). Must be re-applied after every Ollama update because updates re-extract the library and re-enable the crash.
